title: Core 010 jar-carton overlap and near-gap comparison
alt_text: A photo of a jar behind a carton is followed by two unshaded line studies from the same view. In the first, a jar line wrongly continues across the carton and a short carton edge meets the jar. In the second, the jar line stops at the carton boundary and the lower carton contour leaves the small reference gap. The T-like meeting is contextual to this arrangement.
caption: Compare the jar’s interrupted contour and the separate lower gap with the photo. Here the T-like meeting is one piece of evidence, not a universal rule.
